text:
Situation: Vancomycin hydrochloride is not on FDA's drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 277 vials of the 1.25 g presentation (18.2 days) and 412 bags of the 1 g/200 mL presentation (29.7 days). Corvale General holds 338 vials of the 1.25 g presentation (21.3 days) and 447 bags of the 1 g/200 mL presentation (27.6 days).

Why (FDA record): A prior FDA shortage posting for Hospira, Inc., a Pfizer Company, was marked To Be Discontinued with an initial posting date of 2025-11-14. No current FDA shortage listing exists for this product.

Our position: Current inventory provides 18 to 30 days of supply across both campuses and both presentations. No active FDA shortage is posted. Multiple alternative manufacturers are not on FDA's shortage list today.

Recommended actions:
1. Place orders with Avenacy, LLC as the top-ranked purchasing option (buyer approves).
2. Qualify Baxter Healthcare Corporation as a secondary source (buyer approves).
3. Qualify BluePoint Laboratories as a tertiary source (buyer approves).
4. Qualify Camber Pharmaceuticals, Inc. as a quaternary source (buyer approves).
5. Qualify Civica, Inc. as a quinary source (buyer approves).
6. Monitor FDA shortage list weekly for status changes (buyer approves).
7. Report inventory levels to P&T committee at next scheduled meeting (buyer approves).

Not recommended: No clinical protocol changes or formulary substitutions at this time.
